rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH lung_doids AS (
  -- DOIDs for diseases with 'lung' in their name
  SELECT id::bigint AS doid
  FROM disease
  WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%lung%'
),
lung_uberons AS (
  -- UBERON ids for anatomical entities with 'lung' in their name
  SELECT id AS uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM anatomical_entity
  WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%lung%'
),
-- bring cancer_tissue mapping (doid -> uberon)
cancer_tissue_uberon AS (
  SELECT doid, uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM cancer_tissue
),
-- differential_expression rows filtered to lung DOIDs (direct)
de_lung_direct AS (
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    doid,
    log2fc,
    adjpvalue,
    pvalue,
    expression_change_direction,
    subjects_total
  FROM differential_expression
  WHERE doid IN (SELECT doid FROM lung_doids)
    AND gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(gene_symbol) <> ''
),
-- healthy_expression rows filtered to lung uberons (direct anatomical match)
he_lung_direct AS (
  SELECT
    he.ensembl_gene_id,
    he.uberon_anatomical_id,
    he.expression_level_gene_relative,
    he.expression_score,
    he.expression_rank_score,
    he.call_quality
  FROM healthy_expression he
  WHERE he.uberon_anatomical_id IN (SELECT uberon_anatomical_id FROM lung_uberons)
),
-- differential_expression rows for diseases that map to lung via cancer_tissue (disease -> cancer_tissue -> de)
de_via_cancertissue AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol,
    ct.doid,
    ct.uberon_anatomical_id,
    de.log2fc,
    de.adjpvalue,
    de.pvalue,
    de.expression_change_direction,
    de.subjects_total
  FROM cancer_tissue_uberon ct
  JOIN differential_expression de ON de.doid = ct.doid
  WHERE ct.doid IN (SELECT doid FROM lung_doids)
    AND de.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(de.gene_symbol) <> ''
),
-- healthy_expression rows for uberons linked from lung cancer_tissue entries (disease -> cancer_tissue -> healthy_expression)
he_via_cancertissue AS (
  SELECT
    he.ensembl_gene_id,
    ct.doid,
    ct.uberon_anatomical_id,
    he.expression_level_gene_relative,
    he.expression_score,
    he.expression_rank_score,
    he.call_quality
  FROM cancer_tissue_uberon ct
  JOIN healthy_expression he ON he.uberon_anatomical_id = ct.uberon_anatomical_id
  WHERE ct.doid IN (SELECT doid FROM lung_doids)
),
-- map ensembl -> gene_symbol for healthy expressions
he_direct_with_symbol AS (
  SELECT
    x.ensembl_gene_id,
    x.gene_symbol,
    he.uberon_anatomical_id,
    he.expression_level_gene_relative,
    he.expression_score
  FROM he_lung_direct he
  JOIN xref_gene_ensembl x ON he.ensembl_gene_id = x.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE x.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND trim(x.gene_symbol) <> ''
),
he_via_ct_with_symbol AS (
  SELECT
    x.ensembl_gene_id,
    x.gene_symbol,
    he.doid,
    he.uberon_anatomical_id,
    he.expression_level_gene_relative,
    he.expression_score
  FROM he_via_cancertissue he
  JOIN xref_gene_ensembl x ON he.ensembl_gene_id = x.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE x.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND trim(x.gene_symbol) <> ''
)
-- final union of distinct gene symbols with provenance and evidence fields
SELECT DISTINCT
  g.gene_symbol,
  src.source_table,
  src.evidence_field AS evidence_field
FROM (
  -- 1) differential_expression direct
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    'differential_expression' AS source_table,
    'log2fc=' || coalesce(log2fc::text, '') || ';adjpvalue=' || coalesce(adjpvalue::text, '') AS evidence_field
  FROM de_lung_direct

  UNION

  -- 2) healthy_expression direct (mapped to gene_symbol via xref)
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    'healthy_expression' AS source_table,
    'expr_level=' || coalesce(expression_level_gene_relative, '') || ';expr_score=' || coalesce(expression_score::text, '') AS evidence_field
  FROM he_direct_with_symbol

  UNION

  -- 3) differential_expression via cancer_tissue mapping
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    'cancer_tissue' AS source_table,
    'doid=' || coalesce(doid::text, '') || ';uberon=' || coalesce(uberon_anatomical_id, '') AS evidence_field
  FROM de_via_cancertissue

  UNION

  -- 4) healthy_expression via cancer_tissue mapping
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    'cancer_tissue' AS source_table,
    'doid=' || coalesce(doid::text, '') || ';uberon=' || coalesce(uberon_anatomical_id, '') || ';expr_level=' || coalesce(expression_level_gene_relative, '') || ';expr_score=' || coalesce(expression_score::text, '') AS evidence_field
  FROM he_via_ct_with_symbol
) AS src
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT trim(src.gene_symbol) AS gene_symbol
) g ON g.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND g.gene_symbol <> ''
ORDER BY g.gene_symbol

rows.question: Show me all biomarkers on the EDRN platform with type protein in phase two.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH edrn_biomarker_type_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    qa_state,
    -- canonicalized/normalized biomarker_title: trim surrounding whitespace and collapse internal multi-space to single space
    regexp_replace(trim(biomarker_title), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS biomarker_title,
    -- canonicalized biomarker_type: lower-case, trim, map common variants to canonical categories
    CASE
      WHEN biomarker_type IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE (
        CASE
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^gene$' THEN 'gene'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(protein|protein\\s+expression|expr|expression)$' THEN 'protein'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(mutation|mut|variant|genetic variant|somatic mutation)$' THEN 'mutation'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(methylation|epigenetic)$' THEN 'methylation'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(rna|mrna|transcript|gene expression)$' THEN 'rna'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(mi?r?na|micro ?rna)$' THEN 'mirna'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(metabolite|metabolomics)$' THEN 'metabolite'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(imaging|radiology|radiographic)$' THEN 'imaging'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(panel|multi[- ]gene|multiplex)$' THEN 'panel'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(antibody|autoantibody)$' THEN 'antibody'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) ~ '^(other|unknown|unspecified)$' THEN 'other'
          ELSE lower(trim(biomarker_type))
        END
      )
    END AS biomarker_type,
    uberon_anatomical_id,
    phase
  FROM biomarker_edrn
)
SELECT
  id,
  qa_state,
  biomarker_title,
  biomarker_type,
  uberon_anatomical_id,
  phase
FROM edrn_biomarker_type_canonical
WHERE biomarker_type = 'protein'
  AND lower(phase) = 'two'
ORDER BY id

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_to_disease_links_from_fda_test AS (
  SELECT
    bft.test_trade_name,
    bft.test_submission,
    bft.biomarker_origin,
    bft.doid,
    bfn.ncit_biomarker,
    bfd.biomarker_drug
  FROM biomarker_fda_test bft
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_ncit_term bfn
    ON bfn.biomarker_fda_id = bft.test_trade_name
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_drug bfd
    ON bfd.biomarker_fda_id = bft.test_trade_name
),
biomarker_base AS (
  SELECT
    b.id,
    b.gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description
  FROM biomarker b
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  bb.gene_symbol,
  bb.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_base bb
JOIN biomarker_to_disease_links_from_fda_test fda
  ON bb.gene_symbol = fda.ncit_biomarker
  OR bb.gene_symbol = fda.biomarker_drug
  OR bb.gene_symbol = fda.biomarker_origin
JOIN disease d
  ON fda.doid = d.id
WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
ORDER BY bb.gene_symbol
